rationale: The previous iteration increased base_speed to 1.4 and softened sensor_weights to reduce aggressive steering, aiming to improve control on the s-bend track. However, the s-bend race still ended off track with one line loss event and increased steering oscillation, indicating the controller remains challenged by sharper curves. To address this, I reduce base_speed slightly to 1.3 to improve control and reduce the risk of overshoot on tight bends. I also decrease kd from 1.0 to 0.8 to further dampen oscillations and jitter, enhancing stability. Additionally, I increase sensor_weights magnitude slightly to [-1.4, -0.7, 0, 0.7, 1.4] to test if a bit more steering sensitivity helps anticipate curves better without causing excessive oscillation. The geometry remains unchanged as it has proven effective. I continue to request comprehensive observations to monitor completion, progress, errors, line loss events, steering oscillation, and control effort, to evaluate the impact of these adjustments in the next race.
